alt: A long transparent strip holds four small square shapes: a pink square, a yellow smiley face sticker, a blue circle, and a teal square. To the right, a dark blue square displays a white sticker with a wavy line design.
caption: A collection of colorful adhesive stickers and a white marker on a dotted surface
description: Several small, square pieces of colored material are arranged neatly along a long, clear strip, including a pink sheet, a yellow smiley face with a peeling corner, a blue circle, and a teal square. To the right, a blue felt-like square features a white sticker with a wavy line, and a stylized tool handle extends vertically from the top.
